output.scope_note: The paper is an MD study of a LiPF6/polypropylene carbonate solid polymer electrolyte that reports simulated ionic conductivities (Li+ and PF6- transport), so it is in scope.

records.measurement_method: out-of-equilibrium MD under electric field, extrapolated with Arrhenius law
records.evidence_quote: an ionic conductivity optimum of ∼ 6.5×10−5 S/cm is observed for a salt concentration between 1.0 and 1.1 mol/kg
records.notes: Extrapolated from high-temperature MD (600-800 K) to 353 K via Arrhenius law; value is the conductivity maximum at the optimum salt concentration, not a single composition. Activation energies in the paper (14.4-15.6) are in kcal/mol, not eV, so left null. Nernst-Einstein values (1.5×10−3 S/cm) are not true ionic conductivity and were not recorded.
